medical_necessity_criteria: Symptoms persisting > 6 weeks despite conservative treatment
Prior imaging showing abnormality requiring follow-up
Neurological deficits documented on exam
Failure of >= 2 lines of first-line therapy
High clinical suspicion for malignancy or infection
typical_denial_reasons: Insufficient documentation of conservative treatment failure
Missing clinical notes supporting medical necessity
appeal_evidence_terms: MRI brain clinical utility systematic review

medical_necessity_criteria: Low back pain persisting > 6 weeks with documented conservative treatment failure
Neurological deficits: weakness, sensory loss, or reflex changes
Failure of physical therapy (>=6 weeks) and NSAIDs
Clinical suspicion for malignancy, infection, or fracture (red flags)
Progressive neurological symptoms
typical_denial_reasons: Acute presentation < 6 weeks without red flags
No documented trial of physical therapy
appeal_evidence_terms: lumbar MRI low back pain clinical guidelines appropriateness
ACP low back pain imaging criteria

medical_necessity_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis by rheumatologist
Failure of >= 2 conventional DMARDs (methotrexate + one other) at adequate dose and duration (>=3 months each)
Active disease: DAS28 score > 3.2 or CDAI > 10
No active TB or serious infection
Negative hepatitis B/C screening
Current or planned DMARD combination therapy
typical_denial_reasons: TB screening not completed or positive
appeal_evidence_terms: biologic therapy rheumatoid arthritis DMARD failure clinical trial

medical_necessity_criteria: BMI >= 40 kg/m2, OR BMI >= 35 kg/m2 with obesity-related comorbidity
Documented failure of medically supervised weight loss program (>=6 months)
Psychiatric clearance completed
No active substance use disorder
Nutritional counseling completed
Ability to comply with post-operative dietary requirements
typical_denial_reasons: 6-month supervised weight loss program not completed or not documented
appeal_evidence_terms: bariatric surgery outcomes diabetes remission RCT
RYGB sleeve gastrectomy long term outcomes

medical_necessity_criteria: Positive or equivocal non-invasive stress test
Symptoms refractory to maximal medical therapy
High pre-test probability of obstructive CAD
Hemodynamically significant valvular disease evaluation
Failed non-invasive imaging (inconclusive result)
typical_denial_reasons: Low pre-test probability without adequate documentation
Symptoms not refractory to medical management
appeal_evidence_terms: cardiac catheterization appropriateness criteria AUC coronary artery disease
invasive coronary angiography guidelines ACC AHA

medical_necessity_criteria: Personal history of breast/ovarian cancer diagnosed <=50
>=1 first-degree relative with BRCA-related cancer
Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry with any breast/ovarian cancer
Colorectal cancer with MSI-H or MMR deficiency
Family history meeting Amsterdam II criteria for Lynch syndrome
typical_denial_reasons: Genetic counseling not completed prior to testing
Testing does not meet NCCN guideline criteria
Results would not change clinical management
appeal_evidence_terms: BRCA genetic testing clinical utility hereditary breast ovarian cancer
NCCN genetic testing guidelines hereditary cancer
